The starter tutorial excerpt only introduces the setup and says "llama3.1 8B served through `Ollama`" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/getting_started/starter_example_local.md]. It doesn't include the code that configures the Ollama LLM, so it doesn't show a timeout.

A 60-second value appears in other LlamaIndex docs, but those aren't the starter example. The general local-LLM guide has "request_timeout=60.0," [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/using_llms.md], and the FAQ uses the same setting [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/getting_started/faq.md]. The starter tutorial itself may use the same value, but I can't confirm that from this excerpt.
